messages:
anna: Quick heads up — targetting docs/site deploy for v1.12.0 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need SDK docs regen + changelog bump merged by EOD today. Anyone hitting blockers?

mike: I can do the changelog nudge. Which PR is the source of truth for the release notes?

anna: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 — contains the new features + migration notes. Needs an extra 👀 on the SDK usage snippet.

sarah: @mike I left one nit in the examples section (path param ordering). Not a blocker, but will be clean to fix before publish.

mike: On it, will push a tiny commit to fix the param order. ETA 30m. :thumbsup:

chris: SDK regen question — we made a minor change to the streaming client that affects examples. After regen, examples will switch to `client.stream()` instead of `client.openStream()`. Any objections?

anna: That's fine, just make sure the migration note calls it out. Also update the code sample in the changelog PR.

chris: Will do. Plan for regen: checkout release/v1.12 branch, run scripts/regen-sdk-docs.sh for js & py, then push docs artifacts to docsite-staging. Command I plan to use:

```bash
git checkout release/v1.12
./scripts/regen-sdk-docs.sh --langs js py
yarn workspace @redwood/docs build
# push to staging: CI will pick up the branch doc artifacts
```

sarah: CI note — docsite pipeline (docsite-prod) only picks up the `release/*` branch builds if the docs manifest includes the release tag. Make sure the `docs/manifest.yml` has `v1.12.0` listed.

anna: Good catch. I updated manifest in the changelog PR but if mike rebases it might get lost. Please double-check after your commits.

mike: Rebased, fixed the example, and added the manifest entry. Pushed as force to PR branch. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 (updated)

build-bot: build 4392 (docs PR 478) — js docs: success, py docs: success, link: https://ci.redwood.inference/builds/4392/artifacts

chris: Ok regen started locally, will push a regen branch `release/v1.12-docs-regen` when done.

anna: After regen branch is pushed, please tag me. I want to do a quick spot-check on the console pages (routes, examples) around 9:15 PT tomorrow before the 10:00 deploy.

chris: tagged and pushed: branch `release/v1.12-docs-regen` -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/compare/release/v1.12...release/v1.12-docs-regen

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window for docsite-prod: 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT). Approvals required: 1 release lead + 1 docs owner.

anna: I approve once SARAH gives the final ✅ on manifest/links. Sarah?

sarah: Quick link smoke-test passed (openapi links, console snippets). One small broken anchor on the SDK-js streaming page — I can patch and push to the regen branch in 10m.

chris: Patch pushed. Run CI again?

build-bot: build 4398 (regen branch) — docs build success, staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.inference/v1.12/ (expires in 48h)

anna: Spot-check complete. Everything looks good. Final checklist for tomorrow: merge changelog PR, merge regen branch into release/v1.12, tag v1.12.0, then deploy docsite-prod during the window. I'll ping on the release channel 15m before deploy.

mike: I'll merge changelog PR now.

chris: I'll merge regen into release/v1.12 after Mike's merge to avoid conflicts.

mike: changelog PR merged. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 — merged by mike (changelog + manifest)

chris: merged regen into release/v1.12 and created tag v1.12.0.

deploy-bot: docsite-prod deploy started for tag v1.12.0

anna: monitoring logs — watching for 500s on console examples route.

build-bot: docsite deploy logs: all services healthy, cache warm, CDN update propagated.

anna: :tada: deploy successful. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. I'll follow up with a short post in #general and update the release checklist doc.

mike: Nice work :clap: 

sarah: great job team :rocket:
